Deltoid Plate Study

Cross-atlas comparison for Yusuf's shoulder series · Bourgery & Jacob (Pl. 83, 107) · Vesalius, Fabrica 1543 (Tables I, II, IX) · Gray's Anatomy 1918 (Figs. 409–410)
Organised by muscle — one section each for deltoid · trapezius · pectoralis major · latissimus dorsi · infraspinatus, showing every plate that carries it with its key and the atlas's own legend wording. Filter with the chips below; the plates and the key ledger are in the Appendix.
📌 Yusuf (2026‑07‑24): “the nerve‑root relationship is clearer in the lateral view.”  Lateral coverage here: Vesalius Table II (true lateral) · Gray Fig. 410 (antero‑lateral deltoid) · Bourgery Pl. 107 (external shoulder figures). Use the Lateral view toggle to isolate them. (These plates are myological — no nerves drawn — but they give the lateral deltoid border where the axillary nerve emerges.)
